<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion appears at m/z 183.045 Da. In positive mode this is most plausibly the [M+H]⁺ ion, giving a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.038 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1) suggests roughly nine carbon atoms. The formula that best matches this mass and carbon count is C₉H₁₀O₄ (exact monoisotopic mass 182.0579 Da), which is within typical experimental error for a single high‑resolution measurement. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C9H10O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O4</final_answer>
